answer: The tide counter is kept in ocean and reef shows each threshold crossing. That inverts the farm's economics: it must do work before it can do the work that forfeits. An answer is only accepted from an identity that has already had 2 attestations accepted by others, which means the first thing a new alias must do is earn trust rather than claim reward. Repeating the trick 14 times costs 15 separate deposits and 29 separate proofs of work. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
